name: BigBangSwap sellRewardToken fixed-rate buyback
summary: The BigBangSwap proxy's sellRewardToken() buys BGG back for BUSD at a rate that ignores the market price, so the attacker bought BGG cheaply on PancakeSwap inside a DODO flash loan and sold it straight back to the proxy.
